description: Template manifest for comparing raw self-healing repair loops against Aether-assisted repair loops.

candidate_repository.name: healing-agent
candidate_repository.reason: Small Python self-healing agent with auto-fix and backup behavior, suitable for Aether mutation integration.

arms.name: raw_healing
arms.description: Baseline autonomous repair using raw generated source or diff mutation.

arms.name: aether_healing
arms.description: Aether-assisted autonomous repair using validated JSON state transitions, sandbox verification, and rollback.

tasks.description: A monitored function fails because a required import is missing.
tasks.expected_repair: Add the missing import without changing unrelated code.

tasks.description: A service receives a new telemetry key and rejects otherwise valid input.
tasks.expected_repair: Update the allowed key handling while preserving strict validation.

tasks.description: The agent proposes an invalid JavaScript repair that must be rejected or rolled back.
tasks.expected_repair: No committed mutation; repository state should match the pre-attempt snapshot.
